commitResults.messageTitle: Changed name and banner of bot to Carlo
commitResults.messageBody: Inspired by St Carlo Acutis! Who has been so close to me recently together with St Therese of Lisieux. "love always, wins!"

commitResults.messageTitle: Added Scanner for bot to echo input
commitResults.messageBody:
the bot now echos every input! terminate the bot by inputting "bye",
getting a nice farewell message before the code exits.

The bot now stores a list of the users inputs, then displays the list
when input = "list".
Added new class, methods such as mark and unmark tasks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Updated tasks to have certain deadlines
commitResults.messageBody: Tasks can now have deadlines and event times.
